title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
summary: Explore lower GPT‑5.6 pricing for Luna and Terra—and how OpenAI’s more efficient models help enterprises deploy AI workflows at scale.
body: Explore lower GPT‑5.6 pricing for Luna and Terra—and how OpenAI’s more efficient models help enterprises deploy AI workflows at scale.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式发布GPT-5.6系列中的Luna和Terra版本，旨在推动价格与性能的前沿突破。新模型通过架构和推理效率的优化，大幅降低了API定价，帮助企业能够以更具经济效益的方式在大规模生产环境中部署复杂的AI工作流和自动化代理。
